LanguageData.CBF_Sw_PickFaction: Pick a faction on the left.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_UnitsHint: All units from pawn lists and pieces. For each row, pick who this faction sends instead. Several targets are drawn by weight.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_ThingsHint: All things from pieces and object lists, such as banners. For each row, pick what this faction places instead.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_WithoutRuleTip: What this faction would get without a rule of its own, by the framework's fallback rule.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_WeightTip: Weight against the other targets of this row.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_FromOtherTip: Rule {0} from {1}, priority {2}. View only. A rule of your own with higher priority wins.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_NoOwnYet: Your mod has no rule for this faction yet. It is created in a file of its own on the first save.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_PriorityTip: If several rules exist for the same faction, the one with the highest priority applies per unit or thing.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_OtherHint: Rules of other mods are only shown, never changed. To override one, give your rule a higher priority.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_FooterHint: Saving writes a file of its own into your mod.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_ForeignFile: {0} is not in your mod and is not changed.
LanguageData.CBF_Sw_AnimalsTip: Also shows animals from pens and vermin. The fallback rule always leaves them unchanged.
